value.rationale: A complete exact orbit-and-basin landscape on the canonical Heawood 6-cage is a natural finite invariant: all 531 recurrent orbits, six distinct primitive periods, 64 populated depth-period classes, and the sharp maximal fourteen-step entry are determined. This distinguishes the higher refractory mechanism from the known three-state spectrum, eliminating 3 and 8 cycles despite lengthening transients. The result is not an arbitrary graph slice chosen solely for numerical convenience.
